{{Quote|Together, we will drown the Republic in blood!|Razer|<ref name="Road to Ruin" />}}
'''Razer''', born '''Shakren san Jukii''', was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], who was a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before becoming a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Star Cabal]] disassembled the Operations branch of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], Razer absorbed the Intelligence Operative [[Cipher Nine]]'s squad into his army, though he had [[Kaliyo Djannis]] arrested, and departed for the [[Battle of Corellia|battlefront of Corellia]].<ref name="Road to Ruin" /> There, Razer was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Razer)|Jedi Knight]], who moments later was killed himself.
